ai_quote: The company, founded by veterans of the robotics and autonomous vehicle industries, is building what it calls the data layer for physical AI.

company.description: Builds recording hardware and AI-powered software to collect, label and organize human activity data for training physical AI and robotics models; also developing a sensor-equipped glove called MaxGlove.
company.name: Maxinsights

geography_quote: The Santa Clara, California-based startup this week announced a $30 million seed round
source_quote: The Santa Clara, California-based startup this week announced a $30 million seed round led by Peak XV Partners , with participation from Tola Capital , South Park Commons , Ince Capital and Alumni Ventures .
